All 39 tests passed (approve happy path, reject path, conflict 409 with detail.conflicts + min_active, force=true bypass, Penugasan bypass, per-day audit rows, personil notifications for approve/reject/force, GET /api/settings/public unauthenticated + branding fields, min_active PATCH, audit month/year filter, schedule summary shape).

Documented cleanup in context_for_next_testing_agent.

seed_data_creation: Cleaned stale TEST Conf users, their schedules (2026-03/2026-04 Pagi), requests and notifications, plus orphan schedule rows referencing deleted users. Suite then created its own fresh users via /personil.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Before running pytest on backend_test.py, always purge stale conflict fixtures: mongosh shift_scheduler_db --eval 'const uids=db.users.find({name:{$regex:/^TEST Conf/i}}).toArray().map(u=>u.id); db.users.deleteMany({name:{$regex:/^TEST Conf/i}}); db.schedules.deleteMany({user_id:{$in:uids}}); db.requests.deleteMany({user_id:{$in:uids}}); db.notifications.deleteMany({user_id:{$in:uids}}); const valid=db.users.distinct("id"); db.schedules.deleteMany({user_id:{$nin:valid}});' — otherwise TestConflictAndForce.test_b_approve_conflict_returns_409 and TestDecisionNotifiesPersonil.test_force_approve_fires_personil_notification fail with 200 instead of 409 because leftover Pagi rows on 2026-03-10 / 2026-04-10 inflate remaining active personil above min_active.
rca of the issue: Not a product bug. TestConflictAndForce seeds 3 personil on Pagi 2026-03-10/11 and expects remaining=2 < min_active=3 → 409. Prior iteration runs leave those schedule rows behind (users get deleted or replaced next run, schedules do not). On re-run, cumulative Pagi occupancy on the same date grows (saw 4-8 rows) so conflict math yields remaining >= 3 and the API correctly returns 200. Mitigation: purge as above (documented in iter5 notes too).
